latest_release.name: V1.71.0 Sound
latest_release.body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. `mo purge` protects projects in use: Build folders with open files or a running build are no longer listed or removed, including projects under non-ASCII paths. 2. Uninstall preserves more user data: Buzz models are kept by default, `--with-data` no longer preselects UTM and VirtualBuddy virtual machines, and containers protected by macOS are not moved to the Trash. 3. No permission prompt during uninstall: Without Full Disk Access, `mo uninstall` no longer measures other apps' containers, so the preview is not blocked by a system prompt. 4. `mo clean` preserves files that tools depend on: Puppeteer browsers and Buzz models are kept, `mo clean --external` continues past files whose size cannot be read, and a shell without write permission is refused with the reason. 5. `mo purge` reclaims more space: A Swift package `.build` folder that contains dependencies is offered as its compiler output only, and a configuration with no active paths falls back to the default folders. 6. Accurate memory and Bluetooth in `mo status`: Memory pressure is reported again, and connected Bluetooth devices are no longer shown as disconnected. 7. Multi-word search: List search matches rows that contain every word, in any order. 8. Performance and layout: `mo history` loads large logs about five times faster, `mo status --json` returns sooner, and long or wide names in `mo analyze` keep their endings and stay aligned. ### 更新日志 1. `mo purge` 保护使用中的项目：有文件被打开或正在构建的产物目录不再列出或删除，包含非 ASCII 字符的路径也能正确识别。 2. 卸载保留更多用户数据：Buzz 的模型默认保留，`--with-data` 不再预选 UTM 和 VirtualBuddy 的虚拟机，受 macOS 保护的容器不会移入废纸篓。 3. 卸载时不再触发权限弹窗：未授予完全磁盘访问权限时，`mo uninstall` 不再统计其他 App 容器的大小，预览不会被系统弹窗阻塞。 4. `mo clean` 保留工具依赖的文件：Puppeteer 安装的浏览器和 Buzz 的模型会保留，`mo clean --external` 遇到无法读取大小的文件时继续执行，Shell 没有写入权限时会说明原因并停止。 5. `mo purge` 可清理更多空间：包含依赖的 Swift 包 `.build` 目录现在只列出编译产物，配置中没有有效路径时使用默认目录。 6. `mo status` 的内存与蓝牙状态更准确：恢复显示内存压力，已连接的蓝牙设备不再显示为未连接。 7. 搜索支持多个关键词：列表搜索会匹配同时包含所有关键词的行，顺序不限。 8. 性能与显示：`mo history` 读取大日志的速度提升约五倍，`mo status --json` 返回更快，`mo analyze` 中较长或含宽字符的名称保留结尾并保持对齐。 ### Thanks Issue reporters and PR contributors this cycle: @viniciusdsandrade · @baryon · @hyeon0208 · @TyceHerrman. ### Mole Mac App If you would rather work in a window than a terminal, [Mole Mac App](https://mole.fit/) covers cleaning, app removal, maintenance, disk analysis and live status, shows everything before it deletes, and adds tools in the menu bar. It costs $19 once, with free updates and a 14-day refund, and you can [download it here](https://mole.fit/download). The CLI stays free and open source.
